images.author: Maarten Daams
images.caption: Prefabricated house consisting of metal with a layer of enamel

brief: Post-war prefabricated Lustron house (c.1949): a one-storey side-gabled box with walls and roof of porcelain-enamelled steel panels in a pale green, a small corner porch with a single steel post, picture and paired windows, a detached one-car garage and a concrete drive on a corner lot with mature trees.

facade.notes: a Lustron (Eau Claire, 1949) in its original 'surf blue/green' enamel: steel-panel walls in a 2 ft grid, a steel-tile roof, a recessed corner porch on a single post, a picture window with a vertical-blind, a matching steel Lustron garage behind on a long driveway; sidewalk, curb and a terrace tree

why.note: the factory house from Columbus, Ohio: enamelled steel panels bolted to a steel frame
Lustron sold a matching steel garage
